# Vendored source revisions

- Dear ImGui: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui at `4be0b47ecc0edd535a40a79f6ceb6f1ac5936483` (core and OpenGL3 backend).
- ShadowHook: https://github.com/bytedance/android-inline-hook at `593f491be68799f03ee3bab71ce5908846437147` (native sources and nested license files).
- Android NDK r27d: toolchain NOTICE retained for the C++ runtime used by the native build; SDK itself is not included.

The source snapshots are regular files, so downloading the GitHub source archive also includes the build dependencies.
